import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Target columns
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Prepare features
X_text = train_df["comment_text"].fillna("unknown")
y = train_df[target_cols].values

# Split for validation
X_train_text, X_val_text, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_text,
    y,
    test_size=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y[:, 0],  # stratify on toxic label
)

# TF-IDF Vectorization
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=20000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=3,
    max_df=0.95,
    strip_accents="unicode",
    use_idf=True,
    smooth_idf=True,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Fit on training data only
X_train_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(X_train_text)
X_val_tfidf = tfidf.transform(X_val_text)
X_test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(test_df["comment_text"].fillna("unknown"))

# LightGBM parameters
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "None",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Train models for each target with early stopping
models = []
val_preds = np.zeros((X_val_tfidf.shape[0], len(target_cols)))
test_preds = np.zeros((X_test_tfidf.shape[0], len(target_cols)))

for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    print(f"Training model for {col}...")

    # Calculate class weight for imbalance
    neg, pos = np.bincount(y_train[:, i])
    scale_pos_weight = neg / pos if pos > 0 else 1.0

    # Create dataset
    train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train_tfidf, label=y_train[:, i])
    val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val_tfidf, label=y_val[:, i], reference=train_data)

    # Train with early stopping
    model = lgb.train(
        {**params, "scale_pos_weight": scale_pos_weight},
        train_data,
        valid_sets=[val_data],
        num_boost_round=1000,
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
    )

    models.append(model)

    # Predictions
    val_preds[:, i] = model.predict(X_val_tfidf)
    test_preds[:, i] = model.predict(X_test_tfidf)

# Calculate column-wise ROC AUC
auc_scores = []
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    score = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], val_preds[:, i])
    auc_scores.append(score)
    print(f"{col} AUC: {score:.4f}")

mean_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"\nMean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.4f}")

# Create submission file
submission = sample_sub.copy()
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    submission[col] = test_preds[:, i]

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
